    BO13a §2.2.5: a reflecting contour splits at one point #

    • Quiver.Path.comp_eq_comp: two factorizations of one path (Levi's lemma).
    • RayCat.split_or_gap: a path whose first arrow is a prefix of ρ and whose last arrow is a suffix of ρₙ splits as v₁ v₂ with ρ through v₁ and ρₙ through v₂, or has a gap v₁ m v₂ between the longest such prefix and suffix.
    • MulBasis.s225_split: for a long σ₁ with a reflecting contour v, the gap gives the D̃₅ tree F8R1A in P/τ; so v = v₁ v₂ with ρ₁ = V₁ ≫ ρ₁', ρₙ = ρₙ' ≫ V₂.
    source
    theorem Quiver.Path.comp_eq_comp {V : Type u_1} [Quiver V] {x y b : V} (w₂ : Path b y) {a : V} (u₁ : Path x a) (u₂ : Path a y) (w₁ : Path x b) :
    u₁.comp u₂ = w₁.comp w₂ → (∃ (m : Path a b), w₁ = u₁.comp m ∧ u₂ = m.comp w₂) ∨ ∃ (m : Path b a), u₁ = w₁.comp m ∧ w₂ = m.comp u₂

    (∃ (a : RayVert P) (v₁ : Quiver.Path x a) (v₂ : Quiver.Path a y), v₁.comp v₂ = α.toPath.comp v' ∧ 0 < v₁.length ∧ 0 < v₂.length ∧ (∃ (g : a.out ⟶ Y₁), CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp (pathVal v₁) g = ρ) ∧ (∃ (g : Xn ⟶ a.out), CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp g (pathVal v₂) = ρn) ∧ ∃ (d : RayVert P) (e : a ⟶ d) (p₂ : Quiver.Path d y), v₂ = e.toPath.comp p₂ ∧ ¬∃ (g : d.out ⟶ Y₁), CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp (CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp (pathVal v₁) ↑e) g = ρ) ∨ ∃ (a : RayVert P) (d : RayVert P) (v₁ : Quiver.Path x a) (m : Quiver.Path a d) (v₂ : Quiver.Path d y), v₁.comp (m.comp v₂) = α.toPath.comp v' ∧ 0 < v₁.length ∧ 0 < m.length ∧ 0 < v₂.length ∧ (∃ (g : a.out ⟶ Y₁), CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp (pathVal v₁) g = ρ) ∧ (∃ (g : Xn ⟶ d.out), CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp g (pathVal v₂) = ρn) ∧ (¬∃ (g : d.out ⟶ Y₁), CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp (pathVal (v₁.comp m)) g = ρ) ∧ ¬∃ (g : Xn ⟶ a.out), CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp g (pathVal (m.comp v₂)) = ρn

    theorem LargeIndecomposable.RayQuiver.MulBasis.split_refl {P : Type} [CategoryTheory.Category.{0, 0} P] [CategoryTheory.Limits.HasZeroMorphisms P] [IsRayCategory P] [Fintype P] [DecidableEq P] [IsFiniteRayCategory P] {k : Type u} [Field k] [Infinite k] {A : Type u} [Ring A] [Algebra k A] (B : MulBasis k P A) (hmin : ∀ (I : TwoSidedIdeal A), I ≠ ⊥ → Statement.IsRepresentationFinite (A ⧸ TwoSidedIdeal.asIdeal I)) (hL : RayCat.LeftCancel P) (hR : RayCat.RightCancel P) (h4 : RayCat.NoCrown4 P) {X Y₀ Y₁ Xn : P} (σ : X ⟶ Y₀) (ρ : X ⟶ Y₁) (ρn : Xn ⟶ Y₀) (hσ : RayCat.IsLong σ) (hρl : ¬RayCat.IsLong ρ) (hρnl : ¬RayCat.IsLong ρn) (hρ0 : ρ ≠ 0) (hρn0 : ρn ≠ 0) (hv1 : ¬∃ (c : Y₀ ⟶ Y₁), CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp σ c = ρ) (hv2 : ¬∃ (c : Y₁ ⟶ Y₀), CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp ρ c = σ) (hq1 : ¬∃ (c : Xn ⟶ X), CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp c σ = ρn) (hq2 : ¬∃ (c : X ⟶ Xn), CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp c ρn = σ) {a' b' : P} (τ : a' ⟶ b') (hτ : RayCat.IsLong τ) (hτσ : ¬FactorsThroughMorphism τ σ) {b c : RayCat.RayVert P} (α : RayCat.RayVert.mk X ⟶ b) (v' : Quiver.Path b (RayCat.RayVert.mk Y₀)) (u : Quiver.Path (RayCat.RayVert.mk X) c) (ω : c ⟶ RayCat.RayVert.mk Y₀) (hvu : α.toPath.comp v' = u.cons ω) (hv : RayCat.pathVal (α.toPath.comp v') = σ) (hα : ∃ (g : b.out ⟶ Y₁), CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp (↑α) g = ρ) (hω : ∃ (g : Xn ⟶ c.out), CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp g ↑ω = ρn) :
    ∃ (a : RayCat.RayVert P) (v₁ : Quiver.Path (RayCat.RayVert.mk X) a) (v₂ : Quiver.Path a (RayCat.RayVert.mk Y₀)) (ρ' : a.out ⟶ Y₁) (ρn' : Xn ⟶ a.out), v₁.comp v₂ = α.toPath.comp v' ∧ 0 < v₁.length ∧ 0 < v₂.length ∧ CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp (RayCat.pathVal v₁) ρ' = ρ ∧ CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp ρn' (RayCat.pathVal v₂) = ρn ∧ CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp ρn' ρ' = 0 ∧ ∃ (d : RayCat.RayVert P) (e : a ⟶ d) (p₂ : Quiver.Path d (RayCat.RayVert.mk Y₀)), v₂ = e.toPath.comp p₂ ∧ ¬∃ (g : d.out ⟶ Y₁), CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp (CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp (RayCat.pathVal v₁) ↑e) g = ρ

    A reflecting contour splits at one point (the gap gives the D̃₅ tree F8R1A in P/τ; figure 2.1 at the split point gives the zero relation). Here ρ is the valley neighbour and ρn the peak neighbour of the long σ.
